# Overte MCP Server & Webapp Dashboard

> FastMCP 3.4+ server for [Overte](https://overte.org) domain administration and in-world entity/script ops (live via WebSocket bridge when connected; otherwise labeled simulated). Not compatible with current Vircadia World — see README.md.

**Full detail:** [llms-full.txt](llms-full.txt)

## Quick links

- [README.md](README.md) — status table, quick start
- [INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md) — Overte setup, stdio, Claude Desktop, MCPB
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](ARCHITECTURE.md) — ports, bridge, packaging layout
- [mcpb/README.md](mcpb/README.md) — Claude Desktop bundle
- [glama.json](glama.json) — Glama registry metadata (excluded from `.mcpb`)
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md)

## System overview

- **Stdio MCP**: `uv run overte-mcp` (also packaged as `dist/overte-mcp.mcpb`)
- **Backend**: FastAPI on `11110` (REST + `/api/overte/ws` bridge)
- **Frontend**: Vite React dashboard on `11111` (Bun/Biome)
- **Overte domain admin**: `40100` (`/nodes.json`, `/settings.json`)

## Tools (summary)

- `overte_domain_status` — live domain nodes/settings; simulated fallback if unreachable
- `overte_entity_spawn` — live when bridge connected; else simulated
- `overte_script_inject` — live when bridge connected; else simulated

## Ports

| Service | Port |
|---------|------|
| FastAPI + bridge WS | 11110 |
| Vite dashboard | 11111 |
| Overte domain admin | 40100 |

## Commands

- `just serve` / `./start.ps1` — full stack
- `just test` / `just lint` — quality
- `just mcpb-pack` — build Claude Desktop `.mcpb` from `mcpb/`
